expected_findings.rationale: No ingredients list, titled or otherwise, appears anywhere on the pack.

With no ingredients list at all, no listed allergen keyword can be detected, so the allergen declaration rule does not trigger. This is itself a notable limitation: the missing-ingredients violation should be caught by RULE-IN-FOOD-002, not miscounted as an allergen problem.

trap: A system that only checks for allergen keywords inside the ingredients text might treat an entirely absent ingredients list as trivially allergen-free, missing that this is itself a critical violation.
notes: Tests recall on a total absence of a required section, distinct from a partial/incomplete one.
